verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a pip-installable Python framework (autogen-agentchat) whose agents can in principle be scripted and run from any terminal, and community notes point to example notebooks (chess, group research) for exploring agent behavior, but the evidence never documents a dedicated headless CLI/terminal-runnable example workflow — the closest first-party interactive tool (AutoGen Studio) is a web/drag-and-drop GUI, not a terminal flow. missing for 10: explicit terminal/CLI example scripts, documentation of headless execution mode, and evidence of an agent verifying its own build output via terminal.
